description_zh: 查看計時紀錄統計與榜單使用說明。
description_en: Browse record statistics and learn how to use the boards.
sidebar_zh: 計時紀錄可依賽道、玩家或車輛查詢。
賽道榜提供最新榜期、歷期及歷代總榜。
有疑問或發現錯誤，可透過俱樂部頻道回報。
sidebar_en: Explore timed runs by track, driver or vehicle.
Track boards offer current, past-period and all-time results.
Report questions or corrections through the club channel.

sections.body_zh: 選擇賽道與路線，查看計時紀錄，也可依玩家或車輛比較成績。
sections.body_en: Choose a track and route to browse runs or compare drivers and vehicles.
items_zh: 賽道榜預設顯示最新榜期，可切換歷期或歷代總榜。
榜期依成績完成時間劃分；日期不足以判定歸屬的成績保留待確認。
已驗證標記表示已核對證據，未驗證的有效紀錄仍可入榜。
items_en: Track boards open on the latest period; past periods and all-time results are also available.
Period membership follows run completion time. Runs without enough timing detail remain unresolved.
The verified mark identifies runs whose evidence has been checked. Valid unverified runs are also eligible.
